Darbhanga Raj of Bihar
The Darbhanga Raj, established by Mahesh Thakur under Akbar, gained prominence under Mahinath Thakur during Aurangzeb’s reign and further under Chatrasingh in the British alliance.
Lakshmeshwar Singh, Rameshwar Singh and then Kameshwar Singh were prominent philanthropists and industrialists during their ruling periods.
The Raj's decline began with Kameshwar Singh’s death in 1962, followed by succession disputes and the sale of valuable assets to cover death duties and alleged mismanagement.
